name: Ulla Birk
role: The mother. Runs the bicycle shop

known.fact: Runs the bicycle shop herself: patches, spokes, tyres, paints frames. The person who keeps everyone in Langå moving during rationing.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
